question: brakes-fjord
answer:
For a **complete left-front brake replacement** on your **Voltrieve Fjord AWD** (370 mm front brakes), you need: [voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md]

| Qty | Part | Article number |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Front-left 370 mm brake disc | **VP-10072** |
| 1 set | Front-axle brake pad set (covers both left and right front brakes) | **VP-10254** |
| 1 | Front-left twin-piston brake caliper | **VP-10345** |
| 1 | Front-left caliper carrier | **VP-10527** |
| 1 | Front-left brake hose | **VP-10631** |
| 1 | Front-left pad-wear sensor | **VP-10670** |
| 1 | Front-axle caliper fitting kit (for one side) | **VP-10709** |
| 1 | Front-left brake dust shield | **VP-10761** |
| 1 bottle | DOT 4 LV brake fluid, for bleeding afterward | **VP-15168** |

The pad set is an axle set, so it renews the pads on **both** front sides; the other listed components are for the left-front corner only. [voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md]

question: brakes-spark
answer:
For a **complete rear-right brake replacement** on the Voltrieve Spark, order:

| Qty | Part | Article number |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Brake disc, rear right | **VP-10917** |
| 1 | Brake pad set, rear axle - covers both rear sides | **VP-10982** |
| 1 | Brake caliper, rear right | **VP-11112** |
| 1 | Caliper carrier, rear right | **VP-11203** |
| 1 | Brake hose, rear right | **VP-11255** |
| 1 | Caliper fitting kit, rear axle - for one side | **VP-11307** |
| 1 | Brake dust shield, rear right | **VP-11398** |
| 1 | Brake fluid DOT 4 LV, 1-litre bottle | **VP-15168** |

The Spark has no electrical brake-pad wear sensor. The rear pad set must be renewed for the complete rear axle, though the disc, caliper, carrier, hose, fitting kit and dust shield above are for the rear-right corner only.  
Sources: *voltrieve-service-guide.md*; *Voltrieve spare parts catalog: brake system*; *Voltrieve spare parts catalog: service items and accessories*.

question: brakes-atlas
answer:
For a complete **front-right brake replacement** on the AWD Voltrieve Atlas, order:

- **1× VP-10176** - Brake disc, front right  
- **1× VP-10267** - Brake pad set, front axle *(one set covers both front sides)*  
- **1× VP-10449** - Brake caliper, front right  
- **1× VP-10657** - Brake hose, front right  
- **1× VP-10683** - Pad wear sensor, front right  
- **1× VP-10709** - Caliper fitting kit, front axle  
- **1× VP-10839** - Brake dust shield, front right  
- **1× VP-15168** - Brake fluid DOT 4 LV, 1-litre bottle  

The Atlas uses a six-piston fixed front caliper, so **no caliper carrier is required**. Its front disc is 400 mm.  
Sources: *voltrieve-service-guide.md*; *voltrieve-parts-brakes.md*; *voltrieve-parts-service-items.md*.

question: brakes-lumen
answer:
Your Lumen can be **RWD or AWD**, and the front brake parts differ: **300 mm on RWD** and **320 mm on AWD**. Confirm the drive version before ordering. *[voltrieve-service-guide.md]*

For a **complete front-left brake replacement**, buy:

| Part | RWD | AWD |
|---|---:|---:|
| Front-left brake disc - 1 | **VP-10020** (300 mm) | **VP-10033** (320 mm) |
| Front-axle brake-pad set - 1 set (covers both front wheels) | **VP-10202** | **VP-10215** |
| Front-left brake caliper - 1 | **VP-10293** | **VP-10306** |
| Front-left caliper carrier - 1 | **VP-10475** | **VP-10488** |
| Front-left brake hose - 1 | **VP-10618** | **VP-10618** |
| Front-axle caliper fitting kit - 1 | **VP-10696** | **VP-10696** |
| Front-left brake dust shield - 1 | **VP-10735** | **VP-10735** |
| Brake fluid DOT 4 LV - 1 × 1-litre bottle | **VP-15168** | **VP-15168** |

*[voltrieve-parts-brakes.md]*

The fitting kit is supplied for **one side**, while the pad set renews pads on **both sides of the front axle**. The Lumen has **no electrical pad-wear sensor**. Brake fluid is required to bleed the circuit after the work. *[voltrieve-service-guide.md]*
